about_zh: 编辑器、终端、构建、测试——日常写代码的那一圈。

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊栏目。它通过精选开源项目、书籍和实战案例，帮助开发者快速感受开源魅力，降低参与开源的门槛，促进开源文化的传播与交流。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a popular community-driven project dedicated to sharing interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub. Published as a monthly newsletter, it curates high-quality open source tools, practical tutorials, and books, helping developers of all levels quickly discover the joy of open source and easily kickstart their open source journey.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是面向 AI Agent 的开源 CLI 工具，一键赋予全网阅读与搜索能力。它零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，有效解决网页访问限制、平台封锁与付费 API 痛点。基于 Python，跨平台部署，显著降低 AI 与互联网交互门槛。
repos.summary_en: Agent Reach is an open-source CLI tool for AI agents, enabling one-click internet reading and searching. With zero API fees, it supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, addressing web access limits, platform blocks, and paid API issues. Python-based and cross-platform, it significantly lowers the barrier for AI-web interaction.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个持续更新的开源项目推荐仓库，累计分享超万个高质量 GitHub 项目，覆盖 AI 工具、学习教程、开发工具等类别，帮助开发者快速发现优质资源、掌握技术趋势、提升编程技能。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a curated list of cool, interesting GitHub projects, sharing over 10,000 high-quality resources across AI tools, tutorials, and dev utilities to help developers discover top projects, track tech trends, and improve coding skills.

repos.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署
repos.summary_zh: IPTV-API是一款功能全面的IPTV直播源自动化采集与管理工具，支持多源聚合、智能校验测速及自定义频道，输出M3U、TXT及API，支持CLI、GUI和Docker多端部署。
repos.summary_en: IPTV-API is a comprehensive automated tool for IPTV live stream collection, validation, and speed testing. It aggregates sources, filters high-quality channels, and outputs customized playlists in M3U, TXT, or API formats. With support for IPv4/IPv6, Docker, CLI, and GUI, it provides a robust solution for seamless live TV playback.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: 基于JavaScript的网盘文件直链获取工具，支持百度、阿里、夸克等八大主流网盘。通过浏览器插件脚本一键解析真实下载地址，突破页面限制，显著提升用户的下载效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a versatile, JavaScript-based cloud storage utility designed to extract direct download links from eight major network drives, including Baidu, Aliyun, and Quark. Leveraging advanced browser scripting, the tool automates the parsing of genuine download addresses, effectively bypassing page redirects and standard speed limits. By simplifying the link resolution process, it significantly enhances download efficiency, serving as a powerful automation tool for users who require rapid and seamless cloud resource retrieval on a daily basis, helping to streamline personal workflows.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多协议代理管理平台，支持 VLESS、Trojan 协议及图形化 KV 配置。集成家宽链式路由、自动延迟测试与多客户端订阅转换，实现一键唤醒与高效运维。
repos.summary_en: A multi-protocol proxy management platform on Cloudflare Workers, supporting VLESS/Trojan with graphical KV configuration. It integrates residential broadband routing, latency testing, and multi-client subscription conversion for efficient ops.

repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Playwright 和 AI 的闲鱼多任务实时监控与智能分析系统，配备完善的 Web 管理后台。支持多账号、代理轮换、定时调度及多渠道即时通知，助用户从海量商品中精准锁定心仪目标。
repos.summary_en: An AI and Playwright-powered Xianyu marketplace monitoring system, designed for real-time multi-task tracking and intelligent multimodal analysis. Equipped with a full-featured Web UI, it supports multi-account proxy rotation, cron scheduling, and multi-channel notifications, helping users efficiently filter and pinpoint desired items from massive online listings.

repos.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆
repos.summary_zh: 影梭（GoGoGo）是一款基于Android调试API和百度地图SDK的虚拟定位工具，无需ROOT权限，适用于Android 8.0+系统。它允许用户自由修改当前位置并通过摇杆控制移动，主要应用于学习Android开发和地图集成技术，亮点在于稳定的定位模拟和直观的交互界面。
repos.summary_en: Shadow Shuttle (GoGoGo) is a virtual positioning tool for Android 8.0+ that uses Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK to enable location modification without ROOT access. It features a joystick for controlled movement, primarily designed for learning Android development and map integration, with highlights in stable location simulation and intuitive UI.

repos.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本是一款功能全面的 VPS 服务器测评工具，支持主流 Linux 发行版及多种架构，通过交互式菜单或参数化命令实现网络质量检测、路由追踪和 IP 评估，适用于 VPS 选型与网络诊断，显著提升运维效率。
repos.summary_en: This script is a comprehensive VPS server benchmarking tool, supporting major Linux distributions and multiple architectures. It provides interactive and non-interactive modes for network quality testing, route tracing, and IP evaluation, ideal for VPS selection and network diagnostics, enhancing operational efficiency.

repos.description: 网络质量检测脚本 - Network Quality Check Script
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本提供全面的网络质量检测，支持多平台与双栈，集成BGP查询、三网延迟路由、国内外测速等功能，可视化报告直观易读，适用于网络诊断与优化，支持JSON输出及弹性测试模式。
repos.summary_en: This script offers comprehensive network quality checking across multiple platforms and dual-stack support. It integrates BGP lookup, tri-network latency routing, domestic and international speed tests, with visually appealing reports. Ideal for network diagnostics and optimization, it supports JSON output and flexible testing modes.

repos.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘
repos.summary_zh: biliup 是一款自动化直播录制与投稿工具，支持B站、抖音、Twitch、YouTube等19个平台，具备边录边传、实时预览、弹幕抓取、多机录制及AI自动切片等特性，可实现24小时无人值守运行，适用于个人主播与内容搬运。
repos.summary_en: biliup is an automated live stream recording and submission tool supporting 19 platforms including Bilibili, Douyin, Twitch, and YouTube. It features zero-disk-buffer upload, real-time preview, danmaku capture, multi-camera recording, and AI-powered highlight clipping, enabling 24/7 unattended operation for streamers and content curators.

repos.summary_zh: BiliTools是针对哔哩哔哩平台的自动化辅助工具，专注于视频解析与数据处理。因收到平台委托律所的法律函件，指控构成侵权及不正当竞争，项目已于2026年7月正式停止维护与所有版本发布。
repos.summary_en: BiliTools serves as an automated utility tailored for the Bilibili platform, focusing on video parsing and data processing. Following a legal letter from a commissioned law firm accusing it of infringement and unfair competition, the project officially ceased maintenance, updates, and all version releases in July 2026, marking a significant loss for the community.

repos.description: ✨ 现代化代理订阅管理平台 | 智能分类 · 专业测速 · 链式中转 · 流量监控 · TG管理 · JS扩展 | Go+React 全新UI 🌍 Modern Proxy Subscription Manager | Smart Tags · Speed Test · Relays · Monitor · TG Bot · JS Scripts
repos.summary_zh: SublinkPro 是一个基于 Go 和 React 技术栈的现代化代理订阅管理平台，提供智能标签分类、专业测速、链式中转、流量监控及 Telegram 机器人集成等功能，适用于个人与企业优化代理网络性能和安全监控，支持 Docker 部署和 JS 扩展，提升管理灵活性。
repos.summary_en: SublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management platform built with Go backend and React frontend, featuring smart tag classification, speed testing, relay chaining, traffic monitoring, and Telegram bot integration for personal and enterprise proxy optimization and security monitoring, with Docker support and JS extensions for enhanced flexibility.

repos.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是一个针对GitHub Desktop客户端的自动汉化工具，通过正则表达式匹配替换英文文本为中文，兼容频繁版本更新。支持选择性替换、预览版开启、代理设置及自动更新，维护成本低，适用于需要中文界面的GitHub Desktop用户。
repos.summary_en: This project is an automatic localization tool for GitHub Desktop, replacing English text with Chinese via regular expressions. It is highly compatible with frequent version updates, supports selective replacement, preview features, proxy settings, and auto-update. Low maintenance cost, ideal for users needing a Chinese interface.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于GitHub Actions实现酷狗概念VIP自动签到，每日自动领取两天VIP。支持二维码与手机号双登录模式，集成多渠道通知与自动令牌刷新机制，确保稳定运行。适用于技术用户自动化获取音乐平台权益。
repos.summary_en: This project leverages GitHub Actions to automate KuGou concept VIP check-in, claiming two days of VIP daily. It supports both QR code and phone logins, integrates multi-channel notifications, and auto-refreshes tokens for stability. Ideal for tech-savvy users automating music platform benefits.

repos.summary_zh: 基于合宙Air780系列模块的短信UART转发系统，通过串口将短信实时转发至上位机。支持短信收发、来电通知、计划任务，并集成钉钉、企业微信等多渠道Webhook通知，提供Docker与原生部署方式。
repos.summary_en: This robust SMS UART forwarding system utilizes the Air780 module to relay SMS messages to a host PC over serial interface. It provides comprehensive SMS management, call alerts, scheduled messaging, rich webhook notifications (DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu), and flexible Docker or native service configurations.

repos.summary_zh: 3X-UI 是基于 Xray-core 的 Web 控制面板，提供一键协议模板、中转分流、多服务器部署及扫码导入等功能，极大简化 VPN/代理节点的配置与管理。支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL 双数据库，具备批量操作与共享订阅，助力个人快速搭建高效稳定的代理服务。
repos.summary_en: 3X-UI is a web-based control panel for Xray-core, featuring one-click protocol templates, relay diversion, multi-server deployment, and QR code import to simplify VPN/proxy node configuration and management. It supports SQLite/PostgreSQL databases, batch operations, and shared subscriptions, enabling individuals to quickly build efficient and stable proxy services.

repos.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用
repos.summary_zh: EcoHub是一款高性能全栈多源影视聚合系统，用于快速搭建私人影视库。它集成自动化采集与后台管理，支持TVBox与鸿蒙原生应用，基于Go与Next.js，提供高性能自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: EcoHub is a high-performance, modern full-stack multi-source video aggregation and collection system designed to help users quickly build their own private media library. It features powerful automated data collection, an intuitive management backend, and a seamless streaming web interface. Supporting TVBox and native HarmonyOS/Android applications, it is built on Go, Next.js, MySQL, and Redis, offering a highly efficient and secure self-hosted deployment solution for personal media management.

repos.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。
repos.summary_zh: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，利用 AI 大模型生成摘要与智能标签，通过归一化防止标签爆炸。支持增量高并发，内置纯规则分面检索网格，提供双语搜索与零依赖 Agent 接口，实现高效知识管理与检索。
repos.summary_en: Automatically crawls GitHub Stars and leverages AI large models to generate summaries and smart tags, preventing tag explosion through normalization. Supports incremental high-concurrency processing with a rule-based facet search grid, offering bilingual search and zero-dependency Agent interfaces for efficient knowledge management.

repos.summary_zh: ring1012/r1-iot-java 仓库提供了一个基于 Java 的物联网解决方案，专门用于控制和集成斐讯 R1 智能音箱。核心价值在于通过 Docker 容器化技术实现快速部署和运维自动化，简化安装与维护流程。应用场景包括智能家居设备管理、远程控制及自动化任务。技术亮点包括跨平台兼容性、灵活的环境变量配置以及数据卷挂载支持，确保高效可靠的运行。
repos.summary_en: The ring1012/r1-iot-java repository offers a Java-based IoT solution for controlling and integrating the Phicomm R1 smart speaker. It utilizes Docker containerization for rapid deployment and operations automation, streamlining setup and maintenance. Applications span smart home device management, remote control, and automated tasks. Key technical highlights include cross-platform compatibility, flexible configuration via environment variables, and volume mounting for efficient operation.
